metadata: <canvas id="0:1" name="Pricing"><frame id="1:2" name="Pricing" x="0" y="0" width="1440" height="900"><frame id="1:10" name="PricingCard" width="357" height="262" /><instance id="1:11" name="Button/Primary" /></frame><frame id="1:50" name="Pricing / Mobile" x="1600" y="0" width="390" height="1200" /></canvas>

1:2.name: Pricing
1:2.designContext:
Frame "Pricing" (1440×900, fill color/bg). Container: max-width 1120, centered, padding space/10 (top/bottom) space/6 (sides). - Title "Planos": Arial Bold font/title (40px), color/text, margin-bottom space/2. - Lead "Escolha o plano ideal para o seu time.": 16px, color/muted, margin-bottom space/10. - Grid of 3 PricingCard instances (1:10), 3 equal columns, gap space/6. PricingCard contents (in order): Starter / R$ 0 / [1 projeto, Suporte por e-mail] / button "Começar"; Pro / R$ 49 / [10 projetos, Suporte prioritário] / "Assinar Pro"; Team / R$ 99 / [Projetos ilimitados, SSO] / "Falar com vendas". Buttons are instances of the Button/Primary component (1:11). Reference code:

Planos

Escolha o plano ideal para o seu time.

{PricingCard × 3}

1:10.name: PricingCard
1:10.designContext:
Component "PricingCard" (357×262). Fill color/surface, 1px stroke color/border, radius radius/md (12), padding space/6 (24). - Plan name: Arial Bold 20px, color/text, margin-bottom space/2. - Price: Arial Bold 32px, margin-bottom space/4. - Feature list: bulleted, 16px, color/muted, left padding 20, margin-bottom space/6. - CTA: instance of Button/Primary (1:11). Props: name (text), price (text), features (list of text), ctaLabel (text). Example instance: name "Pro", price "R$ 49", features ["10 projetos", "Suporte prioritário"], ctaLabel "Assinar Pro". Reference code:

{name}

{price}

    {features}
{ctaLabel}

1:11.name: Button/Primary
1:11.designContext: Component "Button/Primary": padding 12×20, radius 8, fill color/primary, text color/primary-contrast Arial Bold 16px. Code Connect: maps to the project's existing primary button component.

1:50.name: Pricing / Mobile
1:50.designContext: Frame "Pricing / Mobile" (390 wide). Same content as Pricing (1:2) with: container padding space/6 (top/bottom) space/4 (sides); title 32px; the 3 PricingCards stacked in a single column, gap space/6; no horizontal scroll.
